mapper.sql: instance_key, version, status, def_key, def_version, store_key, model_json, content_hash, diff_prev, diff_draft, refs_json, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, acl_principals, data_label
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ont_instance_version ( instance_key, version, status, def_key, def_version, store_key, model_json, content_hash, diff_prev, diff_draft, refs_json, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, acl_principals, data_label ) VALUES ( #{row.instanceKey}, #{row.version}, #{row.status}, #{row.defKey}, #{row.defVersion}, #{row.storeKey}, #{row.modelJson}::jsonb, #{row.contentHash}, #{row.diffPrev}::jsonb, #{row.diffDraft}::jsonb, #{row.refsJson}::jsonb, #{row.confirmedBy}, #{row.confirmedAt}, #{row.aclPrincipals,typeHandler=com.tioka.ontology.infrastructure.PgTextArrayTypeHandler}::varchar[], #{row.dataLabel} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ont_instance_version WHERE instance_key = #{instanceKey} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY confirmed_at DESC, version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ont_instance_version WHERE store_key = #{storeKey} AND status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY confirmed_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ont_instance_version SET status = 'SUPERSEDED' WHERE instance_key = #{instanceKey} AND version != #{keepVersion} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
